description: A shell script used for testing Git's apply command with whitespace ignoring options. It defines patches, applies them, and checks their effects on a C source file, mainly testing whitespace preservation and ignore mechanisms.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expecting specific commands to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting specific commands to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files to check if they are identical.
